prose: The Information reports that Sriram Krishnan, a key Trump AI adviser who left the White House in June, is raising a fund of about $500 million to back growth and later-stage US AI companies, with a priority on national security.
The article is paywalled, so details such as investors and timing come only from the Techmeme excerpt.
highlights: Ex-White House AI adviser raising about $500M
Focus on growth and later-stage US AI companies
Krishnan left the White House in June
